info.description: Log of what visitors actually asked. Doubles as the answer cache (`cacheKey`) and as the editor's backlog of FAQs worth writing

cacheKey.description: Hash of the normalized question. A repeat hit is answered from here, at zero cost

wasCached.description: True when this one was served from a previous answer instead of the model

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens billed at cache-read rates. Zero means prompt caching never engaged
